**State of the recipe.** The recipe's tunable knobs all look flat on the true-mean scale. The per-block Muon lr, momentum, whitening strength, SGD-group lr/wd/momentum, augmentation strength, schedule warmup, logit scale, pooling, averaging and batch shape all sit at their optimum. Every time cut prices at about 0.05 pp per 1% of time. The tip's true mean is about 0.7539 (I138 grand mean).

**Correction to I138.** I138 says the true mean could be spent down to about 0.7525. That arithmetic is wrong. Keeping P(local pass) ≥ 0.6 needs m ≥ 0.7534, so only about 0.055 pp of margin is spendable.

**Ranking.**
- **Priority 5:** Inductor Triton coordinate-descent and pointwise autotuning of the memory-bound BN/SiLU kernels (new node H2.7). This is the one untested systems lever inside the compiled step, which holds about 98% of the time. It keeps the true mean and is a ~70% gate lottery.
- **Priority 4:** stack the best-priced near-miss onto it: block-1 freeze at 0.75, I130's -0.066 pp for -1.7%. The launch rule is pre-registered and uses the corrected arithmetic.
- **Priority 3:** a bit-identical cleanup of the remaining outside-step work (resize in the straddling epochs, a precomputed step plan). Since the cached model kernels replay, it keeps the 0.7556 draw (E083 precedent).
- **Priority 3:** a structural explore, H5.2: run block 3's first conv after the pool. This cuts ~17% of FLOPs. It is screened both at fixed epochs and at time-matched epochs, to see whether it beats the flat frontier.
- **Priority 2:** two time-neutral explores. One tests jitter's true value, covering H1.8.3 (low-res only) and a full ablation. The other tests the whitening eps (new node H1.16), the last inherited scalar never varied.

**Tree hygiene for the next review.** Several nodes are still marked open but are settled by results:
- H1.6 and H1.6.1 are refuted by E028, I104 and I108.
- H1.2.8 and H1.2.9 are refuted by I103 and I098.
- H1.12.x is refuted by I105.
- H1.13.x is retired by I120.
- H1.1.5 is not applicable (I121).
- H1.14.x is closed by I123.

- H1.2.5 is refuted by I110.
